title: MIUT official home page — 18th edition, 24–25 April 2027
publisher: MIUT – Madeira Island Ultra-Trail / Clube de Montanha do Funchal
claims: The official home page announces the 18th edition on 24 and 25 April 2027.
The home page describes MIUT as a mountain race on Madeira through rugged trails, steep ascents and coastal landscapes, from coast to coast.
The latest posts on the home page are the 2027 second registration phase (lottery) on 19 October 2026 and the publication of the 2027 regulations on 17 September 2026.
